data.title: Quantitative Research Internship: Summer 2027
data.description: Overview At Susquehanna, quantitative researchers drive innovation from the centre of our trading floor. Leveraging expertise in probability, statistics, numerical analysis, stochastic optimisation, and machine learning, they play a pivotal role in developing and refining our trading strategies. We are looking for PhD and research master’s students in their penultimate year of study to join our 10-week quantitative research summer internship. Run by a team of dedicated senior traders and quantitative researchers, our education programme is widely recognised as being the best in the industry. Don’t worry if you don’t come from a finance background – we will teach you everything you need to succeed. A core strength of our internship is that our education is complemented by hands-on trading games and project work. Interns are immersed in a real-world algorithmic trading problem, learning about our proprietary dataspaces, novel modelling approaches, and strategy implementation. Join us this summer to see why so many interns decide to return for a full-time career in quantitative research. What we're looking for Research-minded: You enjoy diving deep into a question and building mathematical models to reveal patterns in vast amounts of data. Analytical & detail-oriented: You approach problems with a curious and analytical mindset – building models, interpreting data, and uncovering insights with precision. Clear communicator: You enjoy building relationships with those you work closely with and are comfortable sharing ideas, expressing your thoughts, and listening to the views of others. Class of 2027 or 2028: PhDs (in penultimate or final year) and Research Masters students in quantitative fields such as Mathematics, Physics, Statistics, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Operations Research, or Economics. Successful interns will be invited to join the full time graduate programme in September 2027, January 2028 or September 2028. What’s in it for you: Education: Throughout the internship you will attend classes covering a vast range of topics (Options Pricing, Machine Learning, Data Analysis Techniques, Game Theory… the list goes on!) from some of the most experienced employees in Susquehanna. Collaboration: You will get to work with a wide range of people in the classroom and through your project work; people who share a passion for mathematics, problem-solving, game theory, and technology. Culture: Our non-hierarchical, casual, and collaborative culture allows employees of every level to thrive. Perks: We offer a highly competitive compensation package to our interns. Located in our brand new office in London’s city centre, our office features free onsite catering, a games room and dedicated education space. About Susquehanna Susquehanna is a global quantitative trading firm powered by scientific rigor, curiosity, and innovation. Our culture is intellectually driven and highly collaborative, bringing together researchers, engineers, and traders to design and deploy impactful strategies in our systematic trading environment. To meet the unique challenges of global markets, Susquehanna applies machine learning and advanced quantitative research to vast datasets in order to uncover actionable insights and build effective strategies. By uniting deep market expertise with cutting-edge technology, we excel in solving complex problems and pushing boundaries together. Our Summer Internship is 10 weeks and runs from late June to late August. **We hire for our quantitative research positions on a rolling basis, therefore interested candidates are strongly encouraged to apply early. ** Susquehanna is an equal opportunity employer, and we are committed to diversity and inclusion throughout our recruitment process. If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or recruitment process, please contact us. If you're a recruiting agency and want to partner with us, please reach out to recruiting@sig.com. Any resume or referral submitted in the absence of a signed agreement will not be eligible for an agency fee.

data.title: OTC Middle Office Lead
data.description:
Overview

 

 

Due to our continued growth, we are seeking an OTC Derivatives Middle Office Lead to join our expanding London office.

 

Reporting to the Head of Trading Operations, you will lead the operational support and strategic management and continued development of the OTC Derivatives business. We are looking for a commercially focused senior product manager who can combine deep expertise, middle office leadership, business management, and operational oversight to ensure the effective delivery of product and trade lifecycle management. You will lead and develop the Middle Office team, translating the OTC Derivatives strategy and evolving business priorities into clear performance goals, individual accountability and measurable delivery and business impact. You will support trading in close collaboration with Compliance, Technology, Treasury, Finance, Legal and Risk regionally and globally as well as external counterparties ensuring alignment across the end-to-end product lifecycle while maintaining string controls and operational resilience.

 

What you will be doing:

 

Product and Trade Lifecycle Management

  • Oversee the complete lifecycle of exotic OTC products from execution through settlement.
  • Ensure accurate trade capture, booking, validation, Lifecycle event processing and trade maintenance.
  • Manage corporate actions, collateral processes, financing events, cash, and position management activities.
  • Oversee reconciliations with broker, counterparties, and internal systems.
  • Drive efficient exception management and issues resolution across all supported products.
  • Partner with Treasury on Liquidity and cash optimization managing eligible collateral and collateral postings  and produce outflow projections based on lifecycle events
  • CSA / ISDA & collateral documentation oversight: Ensure we are accounting for margin timing, thresholds, and haircuts in CSA, ISDA and PB documentation in our workflow

Middle Office and Trade Support

  • Provide first-line operational support to trading desk.
  • Maintain robust controls across:
    • Trade capture and booking
    • Trade validation
    • Collateral management
    • Prime Broker relationships
    • Counterparty management
    • Settlements oversight.
    • Cash and position controls
  • Ensure operational stability and support business grwoth initiatives

Product Governance and Business Management

  • Function as the product aligned operational lead for OTC products.
  • Partner closely with Trading, Legal, Treasury, Finance, Technology and Compliance functions regionally and globally
  • Lead Operational readiness for new products, markets, clients, and strategic initiatives.
  • Drive product onboarding and business expansion initiatives.

Financial Performance

  • Calculate and explain daily, monthly, and quarterly P&L
  • Perform P&L attribution and explain drivers of trade and financing costs.
    • Analyse:
    • Margin utilization
    • Funding costs
    • Capital usage.
    • Balance sheet usage
    • Return on Capital
    • RWA usage

Risk Management and Controls

  • Maintain a strong operational and risk control framework (RCSA)
  • Identify assess and mitigate operational, settlement, valuation, and counterparty risks.
  • Lead root cause analysis and remediation of operational incidents.
  • Ensure compliance with regulatory obligations and internal policies.

Technology & AI

  • Identify opportunities to automate and digitize operational workflows.
  • Partner with technology teams to define requirements and implement strategic solutions to enable scale and drive automation and efficiency.
  • Enhance scalability, efficiency, and control effectiveness.

Stakeholder Management

  • Build strong working relationships across Trading, Compliance, Legal, Treasury, Technology, Finance, Risk and Tax both regionally and globally, driving alignment, partnership, and effective delivery across the OTC Derivatives business.
  • Manage relationships with Prime Brokers, Clearing Brokers, and Counterparties

Leadership and People Management

  • Lead and develop a high-performing team of Trade Support and Middle Office professionals, translating business strategy and changing priorities into clear team and individual performance goals and accountabilities.
  • Drive delivery and business impact in a fast-moving, complex environment, adapting team priorities and ways of working as business needs evolve.
  • Manage individual performance and development, setting clear expectations and providing regular feedback and coaching to strengthen capability.
  • Foster a collaborative, high-performance culture focused on operational excellence, accountability, continuous improvement and delivery against changing business needs.
  • Lead the resolution of complex operational, valuation, lifecycle and product-related issues, bringing together the right stakeholders and ensuring clear ownership, timely decision-making and sustainable outcomes.

What we're looking for

  • 7+ years’ progressive experience in OTC operations with demonstrated growth in scope and responsibility
  • Proven people leadership experience, with a track record of translating business strategy and evolving priorities into clear team and individual performance goals, accountabilities and measurable business outcomes in a fast-moving, complex environment.
  • Demonstrated experience building and shaping a high-performing team culture where accountability, collaboration, adaptability and delivery against changing business needs are embedded.
  • A strong track record of managing performance and developing capability through clear expectations, regular feedback, coaching and targeted development, strengthening both individual and collective performance.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field
  • In depth knowledge of trade lifecycle, market conventions, collateral and margin management, with direct experience across multiple product types, including exotic OTC trades
  • Understanding of the regulatory environment in which OTC products exist for example UMR
  • A clear and confident communicator, able to explain complex issues to a range of audiences.
  • Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the confidence to build trusted relationships across the business, both regionally and globally.
  • Able to deliver effectively in a fast-moving, complex environment, balancing competing priorities while maintaining strong standards of control.
  • Knowledge of SQL, VBA and Python would be highly regarded including using AI tools

data.title: Hardware Engineer University Co - Op Placement 2027
data.description:
Overview

Susquehanna is a global quantitative trading firm powered by scientific rigor, curiosity, and innovation. Our culture is intellectually driven and highly collaborative, bringing together researchers, engineers, and traders to design and deploy impactful strategies in our systematic trading environment. To meet the unique challenges of global markets, Susquehanna applies machine learning and advanced quantitative research to vast datasets in order to uncover actionable insights and build effective strategies. By uniting deep market expertise with cutting-edge technology, we excel in solving complex problems and pushing boundaries together. 

 

As a Hardware Engineering Co – Op (Placement) at Susquehanna, you will be working with senior hardware engineers and have the opportunity to use their talents for hardware related activities such as system modelling, verification and design implementation and to see full scale FPGA designs go from initial specification to full production.


What we're looking for

Who you are:

  • Technical: You have some experience of C#, C++ or VHDL And FPGA technologies and related EDA toolsets
  • Education: You are currently pursuing a degree in Electrical, Electronic and Computer Engineering, or a related STEM discipline, at an Irish university, and are required to complete a work placement as part of your course.  
  • Problem Solver: When it comes to solving problems, you use clear and sound reasoning. You’re rational and like to use numbers and data to come up with sensible solutions
  • Curious: You’re eager to learn and develop new technologies. You’re inquisitive and creative, questioning the status quo
  • Communicator: You enjoy building relationships with those you work closely with. You enjoy sharing ideas, expressing your thoughts, and listening to the views of others.
  • Ambitious: You constantly set yourself goals in life and give your all to achieve them. You’re not afraid to put in the effort to reach your full potential

 

What’s in it for you:

  • Education: We are renowned for our market-leading education and training programmes. Getting a “big picture” perspective of our technology is important. You will also join industry lectures to understand trading and delve deeper into the crucial role that technologists play in Susquehanna.
  • Real Impact: Through a combination of hands-on and classroom discussion, you will learn how we solve the real technical challenges of building and maintaining the best trading systems. You will learn about our use of leading-edge hardware and software technologies. With other technologists you will collaborate on live challenges, improvements, and technical issues which are key to the ongoing success of the business.
  • Culture: Our non-hierarchical culture allows employees of every level to thrive. We are not your typical trading firm – the environment is casual, collaborative and we focus on continuous development, no matter how long you’ve been in Susquehanna. 
  • Perks: Based in the heart of Ireland’s Financial Services Centre, and a 10-minute walk from Dublin’s city centre, our employees’ avail of free onsite catering, a games room, and a large in-house gym, to name but a few of our favourite perks. You will have the opportunity to attend multiple social events hosted by Susquehanna, where you will get the opportunity to meet recent graduates, and senior leaders from across the business.

 

 

Interview Process:

Apply > Recruiter Interview > Technical Interview > Offer

 

Applicants must be legally eligible to work in Ireland. 

  

Final tip - We hire for this programme on a rolling basis, therefore interested candidates are strongly encouraged to apply early.

 

Susquehanna is an equal opportunity employer, and we are committed to diversity and inclusion throughout our recruitment process. If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or recruitment process, please contact us. 

If you're a recruiting agency and want to partner with us, please reach out to recruiting@sig.com. Any resume or referral submitted in the absence of a signed agreement will not be eligible for an agency fee.
